data.name: Poorva
data.gender_notes: Poorva is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Poorva means old, ancient, and first. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'purva' which means 'before' or 'earlier'. This name is often given to a child born before a sibling or as a mark of respect to an elder in the family. It is also a name for the first month of the lunar year in Hindu culture. Poorva is a name that signifies the beginning of something new and the progression towards the future.
data.spiritual_meaning: Poorva is a name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the eternal cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. It is a reminder that every end is but the beginning of a new journey. Poorva is a name that inspires us to look forward to the future with hope and courage.
data.etymology: Poorva belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Old, Ancient, First.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Poorva total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
